info.title: HebrewCore API
info.description:
HebrewCore by [baba Hebrew](https://itsbaba.com) is the language layer for products that work in Hebrew. One REST API for:

- **Translation** between Hebrew, English, Russian and more, with RTL/LTR metadata on both sides.
- **Protected translation** that keeps prices, quantities, dates, codes, product names and interface variables exactly as written, and verifies every sentence.
- **Account terms**: a list of names (drugs, products, brands) kept exactly in every protected translation.
- **Render-ready display** of mixed Hebrew and English lines, and **language detection** for code-switched input.
- **Transliteration** and **nikud** (vowel points) for display and speech.
- The **Clinical API** for health products: verified clinical translation, streaming, record-search queries and verification.

## Quick start

1. [Sign up free](https://hc.itsbaba.com/console), save a card (no charge on the Free plan), and create an API key.
2. Send it as a bearer token.
3. Call an endpoint:

```bash
curl https://hc.itsbaba.com/v1/translate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer hc_live_YOUR_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "text": "Welcome to your account", "target_lang": "he" }'
```

## Authentication

Every endpoint except `GET /v1/health` needs `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Keys are `hc_live_…` (production) or `hc_test_…` (sandbox), are shown once, and are stored only as a hash. Use them from your server only. TLS 1.2 or newer.

## Limits

| Limit | Default |
|---|---|
| Requests | 600 per minute per account, across all its keys, on every plan. `429 rate_limited` with `Retry-After`. |
| Characters | Monthly characters set by your [plan](/pricing). Protected balanced counts 2×, nikud and the Clinical API 3×, smartest up to 5×; direction, detection and wrap are free. `429 quota_exceeded`. |
| Request size | 20,000 characters (5,000 for transliterate, 10,000 for nikud). |

Responses carry `X-Usage-Chars-Used`, `X-Usage-Chars-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-Content-Stored` and `Server-Timing`. Errors use one envelope: `{ "error": { "type", "message", "code" } }`.

## Docs for people and for AI

- [Documentation](https://hc.itsbaba.com/docs) with guides
- [docs.md](https://hc.itsbaba.com/docs.md): the whole documentation as Markdown
- [llms.txt](https://hc.itsbaba.com/llms.txt) and [llms-full.txt](https://hc.itsbaba.com/llms-full.txt): an index and the complete docs plus this reference, for language models
- [openapi.json](https://hc.itsbaba.com/openapi.json): this spec
- [API catalog](https://hc.itsbaba.com/.well-known/api-catalog) (RFC 9727) and [apis.json](https://hc.itsbaba.com/apis.json): machine-readable discovery

post.description:
Translate one text between Hebrew, English, Russian and the other languages in GET /v1/languages, and attach RTL/LTR metadata (`dir`, `mixed`, `lang`, `script`, `runs`) to both the source and the result.

**Protected translation.** Add `protect: true` or any protection field (`protected_terms`, `redact_terms`, `glossary`, `listener_gender`, `speaker_gender`, `domain` (`general`, `clinical`, `finance`, `legal`), `date_order`, `date_style`) to keep prices, quantities, numbers, dates, codes, identifiers, product names and interface variables exactly as written. Every sentence is then checked; one that cannot be verified comes back in the source language with `status: "fallback"`. Protection is available between Hebrew, English and Russian, and switches on automatically for these pairs when the account has [account terms](/docs#terms).

**ICU messages.** With `message_format: "icu"`, `text` is an ICU MessageFormat message and the result is a valid ICU message in the target language, with arguments and `#` kept and plural branches rewritten for the target language (Hebrew one, two, other; Russian one, few, many, other).

**Quota.** Consumes the monthly character quota: the length of `text`. A request that fails upstream is not charged.

**Limits.** `text` up to 20,000 characters. Not idempotent: the same request translated twice may differ in wording, never in protected values.

commerce.description: Prices, quantities, the order number, the product name and the date come back unchanged; the date is rewritten so it cannot be misread.

post.description:
Resolve the RTL/LTR structure of one string (`text`) or a whole record at once (`fields`, a map of name → string). Returns the base direction, whether the text mixes directions, the dominant language and script, and two run lists: `runs` exactly as the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm resolves them, and `display_runs` that keep every left-to-right unit (a price, a range, a date, a model number) whole.

**Quota.** Deterministic, no model. Does not consume the character quota; counts toward the rate limit only.

**Limits.** Send exactly one of `text` or `fields`. Up to 100 fields and 20,000 characters in total. Idempotent: the same input always gives the same output.

text.description: A single string, up to 20,000 characters. Send this or `fields`.

fields.description: A map of field name → string, up to 100 fields and 20,000 characters in total. Send this or `text`.

base.description: Paragraph direction to resolve against. `auto` (default) uses the first strong letter.

post.description:
Detect the dominant language, script and base direction of a string, with one segment per language. Built for short, code-switched input such as chat messages, search queries and voice transcripts: a brand, product name or acronym inside a Hebrew or Russian sentence ("PayPal", "iPhone", "API") does not change the dominant language, and Hebrew prefixes joined by a hyphen ("ה-API") are split correctly. Links and email addresses are ignored. Latin script is tagged `en`.

**Quota.** Deterministic, no model. Does not consume the character quota.

**Limits.** `text` up to 20,000 characters. Idempotent.

post.description:
Add full nikud to Hebrew text, for vocalized display, learning materials and text-to-speech, where unvocalized Hebrew is ambiguous. English terms and numbers are left untouched.

The result is checked: `verified: true` means removing the points gives back your text (only the vowel letters ו and י may differ, which does not change pronunciation). When `verified` is false, `nikud` is your text unchanged; send it to speech unvocalized or retry.

**Quota.** Consumes the monthly character quota: the length of `text`.

**Limits.** `text` up to 10,000 characters.

post.description:
Render-ready bidirectional output for one display line. Every left-to-right unit (a Latin term, a price, a number with its unit, a range such as "10–20%", a date, a percentage, a comparison such as "<5") is kept whole and in order, so no digit, range or sign is reversed or mirrored inside a Hebrew line.

Pick `format` for the surface: `html` for the web, React and webviews; `isolate` (Unicode isolates) for iOS, Android 7+ and current browsers; `marks` (LRM/RLM) for older Android, embedded displays and any renderer you cannot test. Pass `base: "rtl"` for a Hebrew line even when it starts with a Latin term.

**Quota.** Deterministic, no model. Does not consume the character quota. Fast enough to call per line at render time.

**Limits.** `text` up to 20,000 characters. Idempotent.

post.description:
Translate up to 50 strings to one target language in a single call, for example the interface strings of a screen or the fields of a product. Results come back in input order. Every option of /v1/translate applies to all items.

With protection (any protection field, or account terms for Hebrew, English and Russian pairs), each item carries its own `protection` block and interface variables such as `{count}`, `{{name}}` and `%s` stay in place.

**Quota.** Consumes the monthly character quota: the total length of all items.

**Limits.** 1 to 50 items, each up to 5,000 characters. A protected batch carries at most 20,000 characters in total.

post.summary: Translate clinical English into verified Hebrew
post.description:
Translate a complete English clinical text into Israeli medical Hebrew for a clinician or a patient. Drug names, doses, lab values, units, ICD-10 codes, clinical abbreviations, identifiers and every number are replaced with placeholders the model cannot change, and restored afterwards. Sentences are translated in parallel and returned in order.

Every sentence is checked (placeholders, numbers, negation, laterality, length) and reviewed by an independent model for meaning changes. A rejected sentence is retried once with a stronger model; if it still fails, the English is returned with `status: "fallback"`. Unverified Hebrew is never returned. Account terms apply, with their Hebrew rendering when one is set.

**Access.** Every key, on every plan. Call it from a server (a browser `Origin` header is refused). Nothing is stored; responses carry `Cache-Control: no-store`.

**Quota.** Consumes the monthly character quota: the length of `text`. Refunded when the provider fails for every sentence.

**Limits.** `text` up to 20,000 characters.

get.summary: Clinical translation over a WebSocket, for English that is still being generated
get.description:
Open a WebSocket (`wss://hc.itsbaba.com/v1/medical/stream`) with the usual `Authorization: Bearer` key, from your server. Use it when the English text is itself streaming from a language model: send it as it arrives and receive verified Hebrew one sentence at a time, in order.

**You send** JSON text frames (each under 64 KB):
- `{"type":"start", ...options}` once, with the same options as /v1/medical/translate (audience, reader_gender, patient_gender, protected_terms, redact_terms, glossary, date_order, date_style, bidi).
- `{"type":"delta","text":"..."}` for each piece of English, as it arrives.
- `{"type":"end"}` when the English is complete.

**You receive** `{"type":"ready"}`, then `{"type":"segment", ...}` for each verified sentence (same shape as a /v1/medical/translate segment), then `{"type":"done","stats":{...},"usage":{"characters","billed_characters"}}`. Errors arrive as `{"type":"error","error":{"type","message"}}` and close the socket.

**Limits.** 100,000 characters, 5,000 messages, 1,000 sentences and 30 minutes per session; the socket closes after 60 seconds without a message; at most 10 open sessions per account. Each sentence is charged as it starts (3× characters), so a quota stop is exact.

post.summary: Verify a Hebrew translation against its English source
post.description:
Check Hebrew that was produced some other way, for example by your own model answering in Hebrew, against its English source. Every drug, dose, lab value, code and number from the English must appear verbatim, dates must be unambiguous, no number may be added, and negation and laterality must survive.

**Quota.** Consumes the monthly character quota: the length of `source` plus `translation`.

**Limits.** `source` up to 20,000 characters, `translation` up to 40,000.

ApiKeyAuth.description: HebrewCore API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`: `hc_live_…` for production, `hc_test_…` for the sandbox. Create keys in the dashboard.

id.description: Request identifier. Include it when you contact support.

characters.description: Characters charged to the monthly quota for this request.

SourceBlock.description: The source text with its directionality metadata.

script.description: ISO 15924 script of the run: `Hebr`, `Latn`, `Cyrl`, `Arab`, or `Zyyy` for digits and punctuation only.

lang.description: Best-effort BCP 47 language of the run, from its script. `und` when undetermined (numbers, symbols).

start.description: UTF-16 offset of the first character, inclusive.

end.description: UTF-16 offset after the last character, exclusive.

DirectionRun.description: A maximal stretch of text with one direction, in logical order.

dir.description: Paragraph base direction. With `base: "auto"` this follows the Unicode first-strong rule, matching CSS `dir="auto"`.

mixed.description: True when the text contains both strong right-to-left and strong left-to-right letters. Digits and invisible marks do not count.

lang.description: Dominant BCP 47 language, from the dominant script.

runs.description: Runs exactly as the Unicode Bidirectional Algorithm resolves them.

display_runs.description: Runs for display: every left-to-right unit (a Latin term, a number with its unit, a range, a date, a percentage, a comparison such as <5) is one run, so it never splits or mirrors. Render these, or use /v1/wrap.

text.description: The translation, or the source text for sentences that fell back.

transliteration.description: Latin transliteration of a Hebrew result when `transliterate` was true, otherwise null.

TranslationBlock.description: The translation with its directionality metadata.

status.description: Worst sentence status. `ok`: verified first time. `retried`: a sentence was retried with a stronger model and then passed. `fallback`: at least one sentence could not be verified and is returned in the source language. `passthrough`: no model was needed.

source_lang.description: Source language used for protection (detected when `source_lang` is `auto`).

type.description: What was protected: `term`, `glossary`, `number`, `ordinal`, `date`, `identifier`, `email`, `url`, `template` (interface variables), `keep`, `markup`, `code_inline`, `name` (redacted); in the clinical domain `drug`, `dose`, `abbreviation`, `code`; in the finance domain `account` (IBAN, BIC, bank account), `id_number`, `card` (all three redacted), `reference`; in the legal domain `clause`, `citation`, `defined_term` (its `render` is the rendering used throughout).

value.description: The protected source value. Omitted for redacted values.

render.description: How the value was written in the translation, when it was rewritten (dates).

ambiguous_date.description: True when a numeric date could be read two ways and `date_order` decided it.

spans.description: Every protected value, in source order.

code.description: Check that failed, e.g. `term_missing`, `date_missing`, `number_added`, `digits_added`, `negation_lost`, `laterality_lost`, `gender_mismatch`, `meaning`, `placeholder_missing`; finance: `direction_swapped` (error), `direction_lost` (warning); legal: `modality_changed`, `defined_term_changed`.

issues.description: Problems found by the checks. Empty when every sentence passed.

source.example: Would you like me to schedule delivery for 04/03/2026?

text.example: האם תרצי שאקבע את המשלוח ל־3 באפריל 2026?

Protection.description: Present when the request used protected translation.

type.description: Stable error class: `invalid_request`, `unauthorized`, `payment_required`, `forbidden`, `not_found`, `rate_limited`, `quota_exceeded`, `internal`, `bad_gateway` or `service_unavailable`. Branch on this.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Wording may change; do not parse it.

code.description: Finer-grained reason. Equals `type` unless a more specific code applies, e.g. `unsupported_language`, `same_language`, `invalid_message_format`, `message_too_complex`, `payment_method_required`, `server_only`, `upstream_error`, `not_configured`, `terms_limit`, `tls_version`.

Error.description: Every error response uses this envelope.

text.description: Text to translate, 1 to 20,000 characters. Counts toward the monthly character quota.

source_lang.description: BCP 47 source language, or `auto` (default) to detect it.

target_lang.description: BCP 47 target language, e.g. `he`, `en`, `ru`. See GET /v1/languages.

transliterate.description: Include a Latin transliteration when the target is Hebrew.

quality.description: `fast`: lowest latency, for high volume and short strings. `balanced`: the default. `smartest`: maximum nuance for long or sensitive text.

gender.description: Grammatical gender for the reader where the target language marks it. For assistants, prefer `listener_gender` and `speaker_gender`.

store.description: Accepted for compatibility and has no effect: HebrewCore never stores request or response text.

message_format.description: `icu`: the text is an ICU MessageFormat message. The result is a valid ICU message in the target language: arguments ({name}, {count, number}, {d, date, short}) and `#` are kept, plural and selectordinal branches are rewritten for the target language's CLDR categories (Hebrew one, two, other; Russian one, few, many, other; English one, other; exact matches such as =0 kept), and select keys are kept. A plural or select inside a sentence is moved to the top so every branch is a whole sentence; `protection.segments` lists each branch sentence. Always protected; Hebrew, English and Russian. Invalid ICU returns 400 `invalid_message_format`; a message that cannot be verified comes back unchanged with `protection.status: "fallback"`.

protect.description: Keep prices, quantities, numbers, dates, codes, identifiers, product names, interface variables ({name}, %s) and <keep>…</keep> text exactly as written, and verify every sentence. Implied by any protection field. Hebrew, English and Russian. Account terms switch it on automatically for these pairs.

domain.description: `general` (default) for product, commerce, support and interface text. `clinical` adds clinical register and drug, dose, lab and abbreviation detection. `finance` adds a formal banking register, protects IBANs, SWIFT/BIC codes, bank account numbers (including Israeli bank-branch-account), Israeli ID numbers and card numbers (check digits verified; these values are never shown to the model), invoice, policy and transaction references, signed amounts, rates and basis points, and checks that every money direction (credit/debit, deposit/withdrawal, buy/sell, increase/decrease, gain/loss, who owes whom) is kept. `legal` adds a formal legal register, protects clause and section references (Section 4.2, Clause 7(b), סעיף 12(א), § 3) and case and statute citations, renders each defined term ("the Company") the same way throughout, and checks that modality (shall, may, shall not, is not required to) is kept. Any value implies `protect`.

audience.description: Clinical domain register. `clinician` (default) keeps shorthand such as BID and PO; `patient` writes it as plain words.

protected_terms.description: Terms kept exactly as written: product names, brand names, SKUs. Up to 500, each up to 200 characters. Added to the account terms list for this request.

redact_terms.description: Kept exactly and never shown to the model: customer names and other personal data. Up to 200.

glossary.description: Source term → required rendering in the target language. Up to 500 entries. Wins over an account term with the same text.

listener_gender.description: Gender of the reader ("you"): תרצי / תרצה. Hebrew and Russian mark it; English does not. Without it, Hebrew interface text uses neutral forms.

speaker_gender.description: Gender of the speaker ("I"), for an assistant or brand voice: מצאתי, я нашла / я нашёл.

patient_gender.description: Clinical domain: gender of a patient referred to in the third person.

date_order.description: How to read ambiguous numeric dates such as 04/03/2026. Default MDY for English sources, DMY for Hebrew and Russian.

date_style.description: `hebrew` (default) spells the month out in the target language ("4 במרץ 2026", "4 марта 2026 г."); `iso`; `keep` (unambiguous dates only).

bidi.description: `isolate` wraps protected values in Unicode isolates in Hebrew output. Default none; see /v1/wrap.

fields.description: Present when the request sent `fields`: one analysis per field name.

lang.description: Dominant language (BCP 47). Latin script is tagged `en`.

dir.description: Base direction of the dominant language.

confidence.description: Share of letters in the dominant language, 0 to 1.

segments.description: Same-script stretches in order, e.g. ru · en ("CBC") · ru. Latin script is tagged en.

languages.description: Every language found, largest share first.

text.description: Text to classify, up to 20,000 characters. Built for short, code-switched input.
Text to transliterate, up to 5,000 characters.

direction.description: `he-to-latin` (default) romanizes Hebrew. `latin-to-he` writes Latin spelling in Hebrew letters, for name entry and search.

nikud.description: The vocalized text, or the input unchanged when `verified` is false.

verified.description: True when removing the points gives back exactly the input. When false, `nikud` is the input unchanged: send it to speech unvocalized or retry.

text.description: Hebrew text to vocalize, up to 10,000 characters. English terms and numbers pass through.

stripped.description: The text without nikud, dagesh or cantillation. Punctuation such as the maqaf is kept.

text.description: Hebrew text with nikud or cantillation, up to 20,000 characters.

output.description: Render-ready text: HTML with `dir` spans, or the text with Unicode isolates or direction marks inserted.
output.example: הנחה: 10–20% על Galaxy S25 עד 31/12

runs.description: The display runs the output was built from.

text.description: The display line, up to 20,000 characters.

format.description: `html` for the web; `isolate` (Unicode isolates) for modern text engines; `marks` (LRM/RLM) for every renderer, including older Android.

base.description: Paragraph direction of the display surface. Pass `rtl` for a Hebrew line even when it starts with a Latin term.

results.description: One translation per item, in input order.

characters.description: Characters charged to the monthly quota for this request.

items.description: 1 to 50 strings, each up to 5,000 characters. A protected batch carries at most 20,000 characters in total.

target_lang.description: BCP 47 target language, applied to every item.

transliterate.description: Include a Latin transliteration when the target is Hebrew.

quality.description: Quality tier, applied to every item.

gender.description: Grammatical gender for the reader where the target language marks it.

message_format.description: `icu`: every item is an ICU MessageFormat message. Each result is a valid ICU message in the target language: arguments ({name}, {count, number}, {d, date, short}) and `#` are kept, plural and selectordinal branches are rewritten for the target language's CLDR categories (Hebrew one, two, other; Russian one, few, many, other; English one, other; exact matches such as =0 kept), and select keys are kept. A plural or select inside a sentence is moved to the top so every branch is a whole sentence; `protection.segments` lists each branch sentence. Always protected; Hebrew, English and Russian. Invalid ICU returns 400 `invalid_message_format`; a message that cannot be verified comes back unchanged with `protection.status: "fallback"`.

protect.description: Keep prices, quantities, numbers, dates, codes, identifiers, product names, interface variables ({name}, %s) and <keep>…</keep> text exactly as written, and verify every sentence. Implied by any protection field. Hebrew, English and Russian. Account terms switch it on automatically for these pairs.

domain.description: `general` (default) for product, commerce, support and interface text. `clinical` adds clinical register and drug, dose, lab and abbreviation detection. `finance` adds a formal banking register, protects IBANs, SWIFT/BIC codes, bank account numbers (including Israeli bank-branch-account), Israeli ID numbers and card numbers (check digits verified; these values are never shown to the model), invoice, policy and transaction references, signed amounts, rates and basis points, and checks that every money direction (credit/debit, deposit/withdrawal, buy/sell, increase/decrease, gain/loss, who owes whom) is kept. `legal` adds a formal legal register, protects clause and section references (Section 4.2, Clause 7(b), סעיף 12(א), § 3) and case and statute citations, renders each defined term ("the Company") the same way throughout, and checks that modality (shall, may, shall not, is not required to) is kept. Any value implies `protect`.

audience.description: Clinical domain register. `clinician` (default) keeps shorthand such as BID and PO; `patient` writes it as plain words.

protected_terms.description: Terms kept exactly as written: product names, brand names, SKUs. Up to 500, each up to 200 characters. Added to the account terms list for this request.

redact_terms.description: Kept exactly and never shown to the model: customer names and other personal data. Up to 200.

glossary.description: Source term → required rendering in the target language. Up to 500 entries. Wins over an account term with the same text.

listener_gender.description: Gender of the reader ("you"): תרצי / תרצה. Hebrew and Russian mark it; English does not. Without it, Hebrew interface text uses neutral forms.

speaker_gender.description: Gender of the speaker ("I"), for an assistant or brand voice: מצאתי, я нашла / я нашёл.

patient_gender.description: Clinical domain: gender of a patient referred to in the third person.

date_order.description: How to read ambiguous numeric dates such as 04/03/2026. Default MDY for English sources, DMY for Hebrew and Russian.

date_style.description: `hebrew` (default) spells the month out in the target language ("4 במרץ 2026", "4 марта 2026 г."); `iso`; `keep` (unambiguous dates only).

bidi.description: `isolate` wraps protected values in Unicode isolates in Hebrew output. Default none; see /v1/wrap.

code.description: BCP 47 code to pass as `source_lang` or `target_lang`.

db.description: `ok`, or `error` when the database check failed.

text.description: The whole Hebrew document: every segment joined with its prefix and suffix.
text.example: את נוטלת Eliquis 5 mg פעמיים ביום. המינון שלך שונה ב־4 במרץ 2026.

segments.description: One entry per sentence, in order.

prefix.description: Markdown structure emitted before the text (list marker, heading).

suffix.description: Whitespace or structure after the text. Join `prefix + text + suffix` for every segment to rebuild the document.

source.example: You are taking Eliquis 5 mg twice a day.

text.description: Verified Hebrew, or the English source when status is `fallback`.
text.example: את נוטלת Eliquis 5 mg פעמיים ביום.

status.description: `ok`: verified first time. `retried`: passed after one retry with a stronger model. `fallback`: no translation passed, `text` is the English. `passthrough`: structure or values only, no model needed.

issues.description: Why a sentence was retried or fell back. Empty for `ok`.

spans.description: Protected values in this sentence. Redacted names and identifiers are left out.

detail.example: The source says "no known allergies"; the translation drops the negation.

value.description: The protected source value. Omitted for names and identifiers.

render.description: How the value was written in the Hebrew, when it was rewritten (dates).

ambiguous_date.description: True when a numeric date could be read two ways and `date_order` decided it.

fallback.description: Sentences returned in English. Treat them as untranslated.

audience.description: Who reads the Hebrew. `clinician` (default) keeps shorthand such as BID and PO; `patient` writes dosing shorthand (BID, PRN) as plain words.

reader_gender.description: Gender of the reader, the person the text calls "you". Omit when unknown.

patient_gender.description: Gender of the patient in third-person references. Inferred from he/she when omitted.

protected_terms.description: Kept verbatim. Pass the patient's medication and problem lists from the record. Up to 500, each up to 200 characters. Added to the account terms list for this request.

redact_terms.description: Kept verbatim and never shown to the model (patient and staff names). Up to 200.

glossary.description: English term → required Hebrew rendering. Up to 500 entries.

date_order.description: How to read ambiguous numeric dates in the source. US records are MDY.

date_style.description: `hebrew` writes "4 במרץ 2026"; `iso` writes 2026-03-04; `keep` leaves unambiguous dates as written (an ambiguous one is still rewritten). A two-digit year is kept as written.

bidi.description: `isolate` wraps English values in Unicode isolates so "5 mg" never renders as "mg 5". `none` returns plain text.

text.description: English text, 1 to 20,000 characters. Markdown lists, headings and tables keep their structure. Counts toward the monthly character quota.
text.example: Based on your records, you are taking Eliquis 5 mg twice a day. Your dose was changed on 03/04/2026.

query.description: English query for your record search.
query.example: Is the patient still taking metformin?

terms.description: Hebrew spellings that were mapped back to English terms.

text.description: The Hebrew question, up to 2,000 characters.

known_terms.description: English terms from the patient's record, used to map Hebrew spellings back. Up to 500. Account terms are added automatically.

glossary.description: English term → Hebrew rendering, used to map the Hebrew back to English.

pass.description: True when no issue has severity `error`.

source.description: The English source, up to 20,000 characters.

translation.description: The Hebrew to check, up to 40,000 characters.

protected_terms.description: Terms that must appear verbatim. Up to 500.

redact_terms.description: Names replaced before the reviewer sees the text. Up to 200.

date_order.description: How to read ambiguous numeric dates in the source.

verification.description: `standard` (default) runs the deterministic checks. `strict` adds an independent model review for meaning changes.

term.description: Kept exactly as written in every protected translation.

translations.description: Optional required rendering per target language. When set for the target, it replaces the term; otherwise the term is kept verbatim.

note.description: Your own note, up to 500 characters.

tags.name: Translation
tags.description: Translation, protected translation, batches and transliteration. Model-backed: consumes the character quota.

tags.name: Account Terms
tags.description: A persistent list of names that must never change in translation: drug names, product names, brand names. Applied to every protected translation by placeholder masking.

tags.name: Directionality
tags.description: Deterministic RTL/LTR analysis, render-ready display output and language detection. No model, no character quota.

tags.name: Hebrew
tags.description: Nikud (vowel points) for display and speech, and removing them for search and normalization.

tags.name: Medical
tags.description: Verified clinical translation from English to Hebrew, streaming, record-search queries and verification. Enabled per account; keys need the `medical` scope and must be used from a server.

tags.name: Reference
tags.description: Supported languages and the public health check.
